message.content: **Summary:** I read Apple's fiscal 2024 Form 10-K (filed 2024-11-01) and checked the latest quote and news, then bought AAPL within your mandate. Apple's **fiscal 2024 net income was $93,736 million, down from $96,995 million in fiscal 2023** — but that ~3.4% decline was driven almost entirely by a one-time $10.2 billion net income tax charge tied to the EU State Aid Decision; underlying operations actually improved, with revenue up 2% to $391,035 million, operating income rising to $123,216 million from $114,301 million, gross margin expanding to 46.2%, and Services growing 13%. Recent news was neutral-to-constructive (steady iPhone 16/supplier builds, Apple Intelligence rollout, holiday estimates unchanged), and the stock traded around $222.70. I placed a single limit buy order for **44 shares at $222.72** (about $9,799.68), comfortably under the $10,000 per-order and $20,000 daily caps, at a price essentially at the current ask. All activity was buy-only and no funds left the account.
